bridge-credential-sealing.vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of
HoffmanEngineering/3d-print-log-api docs/bridge-credential-sealing.vectors.json at commit
0db10aad16df229764a658063734ef2c380906ce (api#289, story 14a). Don't edit it: copy a new version
from the API repo when the scheme changes. tests/test_credentials.py runs every entry.
